title: Membership in the satisfiable circuit language
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a directed acyclic circuit $C$ on $n$ inputs, the encoding of $C$ belongs to the language of encodings of fan-in-two satisfiable circuits if and only if $C$ is fan-in-two and has an input assignment on which its output is true.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ inputs
